answers.core: This is a proposal to improve core performance
answers.workaround:
it is possible to workaround this way:
```
var a: Array = []
a.resize(100)
for i in range(100): 
    a[i] = some_func(i)
```

however, you cannot "excede" your desired memory without affecting the result of `size()`
